content.title: Chapter 1
content.subtitle: An Overview of Energy Governance
content.body: Thank you for joining us for the first chapter of the Just Energy Transition Module. We invite you to interact with the closing scenario, and to reflect on how you can take action to move these ideas from ambitions into action.

nextBlock.title: Chapter 2: Policy and Regulatory Frameworks for a Just Energy Transition
nextBlock.cta: This chapter examines policy and regulatory frameworks that enable just energy transitions through coherence, adaptability, stakeholder engagement, and investment de-risking.
